conclusion: Inlong deliberately compiles out the initial Moonraker status query and automatic WebSocket startup in perform_connection_async because its MonitorPanel is not used for these printers. Upstream d16ca97380 assumes automatic monitoring in one new disconnect-during-query test; importing that expectation unchanged waits for an HTTP request the fork never sends. Preserve the production policy and test successful connection without automatic queries/streams instead. Keep the upstream explicit-stream shutdown, reconnect, heartbeat and callback tests, which exercise the new implementation directly. This compatibility test protects existing Inlong behavior during upstream integration.
scope: Source and Windows loopback-test review at the local d16ca97380 merge. No new installation or real-printer validation.
